evidence.ACL: acute complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at mid substance (deep and superficial fibers).
evidence.Medial Meniscus: horizontal tear at the body and complex tear (main radial component) at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: radial tear at the body and complex tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.Lateral OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.PF OA: the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion.
evidence.Effusion: Some amount of left knee effusion
evidence.Contusion: Bone bruise at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle, posteromedial and posterolateral tibial plateaus.
